messages:
Jordan: urgent — Sam just DM'd me, can't cover the APAC night shift due to a family emergency. They were primary from 01:00–09:00 UTC. I'm EU and have meetings until 04:00 UTC, so I can't be primary for the whole window. Can someone take primary for that block? If we can't fill, we need to trigger the fallback runbook and notify status.
Sam: i'm so sorry — confirmed i can't make it tonight. tried to find a swap but no luck. truly appreciate anyone who can pick this up. :disappointed: 
Lee: I can take primary for 02:00–08:00 UTC (cover the riskiest hours). I'll need a quick handoff and runbook pointer.
Anika: linking the high-level runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference. key sections: "Initial triage", "Failover to dedicated pool", "Status page update".
incident-bot: Pager triggered earlier (00:37 UTC): svc-inference-cache p95 latency > 1.2s. Pager recipients: Sam, Jordan. Pager details: https://pager.redwood/logs/abc123
Jordan: ok — Lee, you're primary for 02:00–08:00 UTC. Devon, can you be secondary between 02:00–09:00 UTC? If Devon is free, please ack.
Devon: I can be secondary. Acked. I'll monitor alerts and take over if Lee needs a break.
Lee: ack. quick plan: 1) confirm the current alert is resolved or still firing 2) check cache hosts + restart any node with high load 3) if p95 stays >1s after 2 attempts, fail traffic to dedicated pool.
Maria: if we fail traffic, please run the simplified status update template and post to status.redwood.com/incidents. Template snippet: "We are experiencing elevated latency for inference cache impacting tokenization services for some customers. Engineers are performing mitigation. We will provide updates every 30 minutes."
Jordan: runbook snippet (from "Failover to dedicated pool") — follow exactly:
```
1) Open infra-console -> inference-cluster -> pods -> filter by label cache-service
2) Run: kubectl rollout restart deployment/cache-service -n inference
3) If latency doesn't improve in 5m, flip traffic: infra-cli route set inference-service --pool dedicated --confirm
4) Notify status and paging tally
```
Anika: note — if you flip traffic, metrics cost will spike; make sure to call out cost and customer impact in the status message.
Lee: checked the alert: it's CRITICAL on two cache pods (CPU 98%). I'm restarting one pod now.
Lee: restarted pod -> CPU down to 62% on that node, p95 dropped to 0.9s. keeping an eye.
Jordan: thanks Lee & Devon. leaving the thread open until 09:00 UTC but marking Lee primary in rota. Please add a short handoff note in the oncall sheet when you sign out. :thumbsup:
Lee: will do. posting quick postmortem notes in the oncall doc after shift.
Maria: I'll draft the first status update and ping the comms channel so CS gets notified.
Lee: on it — monitoring and will escalate to failover if p95 > 1.1s for > 5m.
Jordan: last check-in: everyone OK? if nothing else, i'll head offline. thanks all for the quick responses.
Lee: all good, on watch.
Devon: standing by as secondary.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: oncall-handoff-check at 04:50 UTC to confirm handover status."
